Que sera, sera 🎶 

The opening sequence of the sci-fi horror series FROM is highly regarded for setting the show's mysterious, unsettling tone, featuring a mix of eerie visuals and a distinctive musical choice. The theme is a haunting, melancholic cover of "Que Sera, Sera (Whatever Will Be, Will Be)" performed by the Pixies. 

The sequence features disturbing, disjointed imagery including old news clips and peculiar drawings that fans analyze as clues to the town's origins. It acts as a "calm before the chaos," often highlighting themes of folklore, monsters, and the town's history.

The intro perfectly matches the show's dark fantasy aesthetic, acting as a portal into a world that is fundamentally broken and mysterious. While some viewers have found the sequence long, many fans consider it an essential part of the viewing experience, often choosing not to skip it.
